propositions: The project portability criterion's matrix cell lists only undifferentiated 'CI', leaving 'projects with no CI provider' unnameable as an alternate shape, so plans with GitHub-Actions-only triggers draw no finding despite breaking non-CI deployments.

A capability whose sole trigger is a specific CI system (e.g., GitHub Actions schedule) with no operation-linked or in-process fallback is not portable and must be detectable as a portability finding.

The authoritative wording must be in the criterion's detection text (.rebar/prompts/plan-review-project-portability.md), and all mirrors (docs/plan-review-gate.md, AGENTS.md) and tests must stay pinned to that source.

Live A/B testing on a scratch plan with GitHub-Actions-only compaction scheduling confirms the new rubric emits a project.portability finding naming the no-CI-provider shape, whereas the pre-change rubric remained silent.
